# coreweave_iam_service_account (Data Source)

> **Private beta:** This data source is available only to organizations enrolled in the private beta and may change before general availability. It is gated by an organization-level feature flag. Contact your CoreWeave representative or CoreWeave Support to request access for your organization.

Looks up an existing CoreWeave service account by its organization and caller-chosen ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coreweave_iam_service_account" "ci_agent" {
  organization_id = "a1b2c3"
  id              = "ci-agent"
}

output "service_account_uid" {
  value = data.coreweave_iam_service_account.ci_agent.uid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The caller-chosen service account ID used as the final segment of the resource name.
- `organization_id` (String) The six-character ID of the CoreWeave organization that owns the service account.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the service account may authenticate.
- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `creator` (String) The canonical resource name of the user that created the service account.
- `display_name` (String) The optional human-readable display name.
- `name` (String) The canonical resource name.
- `system_managed` (Boolean) Whether CoreWeave or an organization administrator manages this service account.
- `uid` (String) The server-generated unique identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The RFC 3339 last-update timestamp.
